title: Write a paragraph about How Parents and Teenagers Feel About Homework
prompts: 1- What homework do you usually do?
2- When do you do your homework?
3- What kind of homework do you like most?
4- How important do you think homework is?
model: I usually do my homework for all subjects at five p.m. I like homework when I understand what it's about. I can do anything if I try. The homework helps me to understand the lesson. My parents often complain that I spend too much time on the Internet. They think that I should do my homework. For me, the Internet is a way to research for school assignments.
